mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production suggests increased economic output, leading to higher S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth is strong but S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates indicate a strong labor market, which should boost consumer spending and lead to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If unemployment is low but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 5 days more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in non-farm payroll employment suggests economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If payroll employment increases but S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate above 5% may signal monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When both unemployment rate and federal funds rate increase simultaneously, it may indicate economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rise but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales suggest strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales increase but S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated.
